import pandas as pd,numpy as np,sys
w=pd.read_parquet(sys.argv[1]+'/works.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean(), g
e,g=est(w); print(e); print(g.assign(d=g[True]-g[False]))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); B=4000; tot=np.zeros(B)
for gn,x in w.groupby('genre'):
  a=x[x.late].r.values; b=x[~x.late].r.values
  tot+=a[rng.integers(0,len(a),(B,len(a)))].mean(1)-b[rng.integers(0,len(b),(B,len(b)))].mean(1)
tot/=w.genre.nunique(); print(np.percentile(tot,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc, est(w[w.date_confidence==dc])[0])
print('window1850-1900', est(w[(w.year>=1850)&(w.year<1900)])[0])
print('drop juvenile', est(w[w.genre!='juvenile'])[0])
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o, est(w[w.origin==o])[0])
print(w.groupby(w.year//10*10).r.agg(['mean','size']).T.round(3))
p=pd.read_parquet(sys.argv[1]+'/passages.parquet')
p=p[p.domains.apply(lambda d:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(d))].merge(w[['work_id','year']],on='work_id')
print(p.sort_values('confidence',ascending=False)[['passage_id','year','confidence']].head(8))
EOF
